# filters.mjs

[Source](https://github.com/uol-library/spacefinder/blob/develop/assets/js/modules/filters.mjs)

Functions for the filters panel in the UI

The filters are loaded once the places have loaded, and the panel is
built again for each dataset.

**Exports:** `getFilterStatus`

## Functions

* [getFilterStatus()](#getFilterStatus) ⇒ <code>Object</code>
* [loadFilters()](#loadFilters)
* [renderFilters()](#renderFilters)
* [setupFilters()](#setupFilters)

<a name="getFilterStatus"></a>

## getFilterStatus() ⇒ <code>Object</code>
Gets the current status of all filters

**Kind**: global function  
**Returns**: <code>Object</code> - activeFilters  
<a name="loadFilters"></a>

## loadFilters()
Loads the dataset's filters from filters.json. The file is optional: if it
is missing, or the dataset has "filters: false" in the config, the dataset
has no filters, and the panel only has the search box.

**Kind**: global function  
<a name="renderFilters"></a>

## renderFilters()
Builds the filters panel

**Kind**: global function  
<a name="setupFilters"></a>

## setupFilters()
Set up event listeners on filters

**Kind**: global function
